events.name: Yoon's Skeleton
events.note: Yoon's remains. Act 1: the Ghost can't touch them. Act 2 (Sib along, Story >= 50): Scene: The Bone (common event 12), Story -> 60.

parameters: Just the one bone. The rest stays here.

events.name: Star-Metal Sword
events.note: A meteoric iron sword shoved into the ground in Grave E. Not taken yet: there's no star-metal weapon in the database. TODO when it's decided.

parameters: ...a blade, standing in the stone. Dark. Bright. Both.
It won't come out. I don't think it's meant to.
Sky-iron. That fell from up there, a long time ago.

events.name: Skull on Spear (bottom)
events.note: A skull looted from a tomb, shoved on a wooden spear. Act 2: take it down for Crew Remains (item 127) and the first Wooden Spear (weapon 131). Taking it from either tile clears both.

parameters: ...a skull on a stick, watching the water.
A child's skull. Not one of ours: look at the teeth.
Someone stuck it up here as a warning.
Got Crew Remains and a Wooden Spear.

events.name: Broken Ladder
events.note: The way up and out through the skylight. Act 2: needs the Rope (switch 13). TODO: give it a ladder graphic, and point Climb at the surface map once it exists.

parameters: If we had some rope, we could lash the rungs back on.
We could tie the rungs with that rope.
Up the ladder, into the light?
...a sleeper, wrapped tight. Old. Very old.
We should be quiet in here.
...a bed of stone. Empty. The wrappings are torn.
This one's been opened. Robbers? In a tomb?
The resin's still sticky. Someone's been embalming in here.
...a crack across the floor. Cold air breathes out of it.
There's air coming up. The tubes go deeper here.

events.name: Skylight
events.note: The light from the skylight over the garden. Page 1 day, page 2 dusk (variable 2 >= 2), page 3 night (switch 7). Move it to shift the light: the pool lands about 4 tiles above this tile.

events.name: Skylight: Cave Shade
events.note: Darkens the cave so the skylight shows. SI_Time resets the tint on entering a map (and when a torch is lit), so this puts it back whenever it has been reset. Change the four numbers to change the darkness.

parameters: Re-darken the cave whenever the tint has been reset (grey below 30).
